# dsh-open-eyes v0.1.2-rc.1

Open Eyes now supports DeepSeek Harness `0.1.2-rc.1`. This release fixes compatibility for plugin startup and image submission, with no new features.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-open-eyes@0.1.2-rc.1
```

Restart DSH Web after installation, then reload the page.
